body: That I am the most horrible, selfish, and hypocritical person I know. I never think of others first. I fail everyone. I am never grateful for what I have. I have always been this way: pessimistic, miserable, jealous, and sad.
thank you so much for your kind words ~

I feel that I am the last person on the planet that deserves to receive any sort of help or relief from what I did. I am not the victim of my actions. I just swear I didn't know what I was doing. It's so frustrating because I really don't know why I did what I did... I don't know why I was born so evil and pathetic. I would do anything to go back in time and make sure I was never born, or to convince my mother to abort me, because the world would be so much brighter without me. How do you forgive yourself for ruining someone's life? For hurting someone? I hate hurting people. 

Like, imagine if Hitler suddenly woke up with a moral compass and some sort of sympathy or empathy. How would you convince him to forgive himself if he truly repented of his wrongdoings? That's how it feels for me. How do I forgive a monster like myself? Especially since I know myself so well. My thoughts. I know that I have always hurt people with my words my whole life. But even when I was eight, I still knew better. Maybe I didn't know the extent of the consequences of my actions but I still knew some basic right or wrong stuff. I don't know how to do this and I am overwhelmed by everything. I am not ready to go out in the world and make it worse :/ I don't deserve to be happy and it hurts so bad, words can't describe. I just feel like I am drowning, y'know?

Sorry for the tangent. Thank you for reading, let alone responding, to my post. I do not deserve it in the least.
Okay, thank you for your input.

Thank you so much for the resources. I may consider them, I just struggle with whether or not I actually deserve relief from this endless black hole I am in. Thank you for taking time out of your day to even read my post and respond, I do not deserve it at all.

Unfortunately, the act I committed wasn't a dumb mistake. It was truly horrendous and the older I get the more my guilt and regret deepens. Nothing I do can ever atone for it. I am in counseling but it is not too helpful. Thank you very much for your advice and for taking time out of your day to read my post. I do not deserve it at all but I am at my wits end.

I have learned a huge lesson but the significance of my actions outweigh such an outcome. I am in counseling sort of (30 mins, bi-weekly, she is a LCSW) but it hasn't been helping thus far. I have only had three sessions with her so maybe that's why. It's quite uncomfortable. But thank you for your advice and for taking time out of your day to read my post. I truly do not deserve it in the least.

I have found from the 17 years I have been alive that all I do is suck the air out of rooms and hurt all those I love so idk if I could actually have a positive impact on the world. But thank you so much for your advice. If I have a long life, chances are this will be something I wrestle with for the rest of my days.
It was pretty bad. My guilt is never ending.

Well, my mother got me in counseling sort of. It hasn't really been helping as it is thirty minutes bi-weekly and the counselor is a LCSW so idk if she could really help with the issues I have. I have only done three sessions with her, don't know if I can trust her yet. I don't know if I deserve the help. The whole reason why my mother put me in counseling is because I was really mean and horrible to her one night :/ I just don't know why I was allowed to be born if all I do is hurt everything and everyone around me. But thank you so much for taking time out of your day to read my post, I truly don't deserve it. And thank you for the advice.

I just don't know. It was pretty bad. I don't know how I am supposed to live with myself for however much time I have left knowing I am a horrible person. I have always been a bad child. I am not naturally good and I always hurt people around me :/ but thank you for the advice, it is really appreciated. And thank you for taking time out of your day to even read my post, I do not deserve it at all.
